lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur aagai karau bina(n)tee je gur bhaavai jiu milai tivai milaaeeai ||
lines.translation: I offer my prayers to the Guru; if it pleases the Guru, He shall unite me with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel lae sukhadaataa aap miliaa ghar aae ||
lines.translation: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa suhaagan naa pir marai na jaae ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does not die, and He shall never leave. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman har ras bedhee jeeu har kai sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is pierced through with the sublime essence of the Lord, in intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mohan mohi leeaa jeeu dubidhaa sahaj samaae ||
lines.translation: The Enticer of hearts has enticed her, and her sense of duality has been easily dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa sahaj samaae kaaman var paae guramatee ra(n)g laae ||
lines.translation: Her sense of duality has been easily dispelled, and the soul-bride obtains her Husband Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, she makes merry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਗਲ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu sareer kooR kusat bhariaa gal taaee paap kamaae ||
lines.translation: This body is filled to overflowing with falsehood, deception and the commission of sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhagat jit sahaj dhun upajai bin bhagatee mail na jaae ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh practices that devotional worship, by which the celestial music wells up; without this devotional worship, filth is not removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman pirahi piaaree vichahu aap gavaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who sheds selfishness and conceit from within, is dear to her Beloved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir paaiaa jeeu gur kai bhaai piaare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, through the love and affection of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain sukh sutee jeeu a(n)tar ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: She passes her life-night sleeping in peace, enshrining the Lord in her heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar ur dhaare mileeai piaare anadin dukh nivaare ||
lines.translation: Enshrining Him deep within her heart night and day, she meets her Beloved, and her pains depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mahal pir raave kaaman guramatee veechaare ||
lines.translation: Deep within the mansion of her inner being, she enjoys her Husband Lord, reflecting upon the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peeaa din raatee dubidhaa maar nivaare ||
lines.translation: She drinks deeply of the Nectar of the Naam, day and night; she conquers and casts off her sense of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach milee sohaagan gur kai het apaare ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu daiaa kare jeeu preetam at piaare ||
lines.translation: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman binau kare jeeu sach sabad seegaare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sabad seegaare haumai maare guramukh kaaraj savaare ||
lines.translation: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh, her affairs are resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug eko sachaa soee boojhai gur beechaare ||
lines.translation: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kaam viaapee mohi sa(n)taapee kis aagai jaai pukaare ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotional attachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak manamukh thaau na paae bin gur at piaare ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most Beloved Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਨਿਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee bholee niguneeaa jeeu pir agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable and Incomparable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel mileeai jeeu aape bakhasanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: avagan bakhasanahaaraa kaaman ka(n)t piaaraa ghat ghat rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem preet bhaai bhagatee paaeeai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee anadin rahai liv laaee ||
lines.translation: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaje har var paaiaa saa dhan nau nidh paaee ||4||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains her Husband Lord. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa sar sabal varatai jeeu kiu kar dutar tariaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifying world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kar bohithaa jeeu sabad khevat vich paai ||
lines.translation: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad khevat vich paae har aap laghaae in bidh dutar tareeai ||
lines.translation: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. In this way, the difficult ocean is crossed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhagat paraapat hovai jeevatiaa iu mareeai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi raam naam kilavikh kaate bhae pavit sareeraa ||
lines.translation: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa ka(n)chan bhae manooraa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1||
